note: Real-animal "plays like" analogs per playable. archetypes/animals/moods/habitats list the playables for each value (primary analogs first); lookup maps every normalized English/German synonym to archetype, animal, mood and habitat ids. GET /api/analogs/search?q=<words> ranks playables for free text such as "ochse" or "großkatze dschungel".

vocabulary.note: Controlled vocabulary for the curated 'plays like' real-animal analogs in data/raw/<slug>/analog.json. Archetypes group real animals into families a player would ask for ('I feel like playing an ox / a big cat'); synonyms are English and German, lower-case, and are what a chatbot or the Animal Finder search matches against. Moods describe the day-to-day play feel. Habitats: forest (woods & jungle), open (grassland, semi-arid hills and scrub, the map's savanna-like country), arid (canyons, badlands, desert, oasis), wetland (rivers, lakes, swamps), sea (ocean & coast), mountain (cliffs, ledges, rock and caves). Each analog.json lists its curated habitat ids in setting.habitats, chosen from the profile text and the profile map.

rhamphorhynchus.name: Rhamphorhynchus
rhamphorhynchus.label: Oxpecker + Parakeet
rhamphorhynchus.headline: An oxpecker riding the sauropods, living in a noisy parakeet colony that copies every sound.
rhamphorhynchus.setting: Wherever the sauropods roam, plus fishing waters

sarcosuchus.name: Sarcosuchus
sarcosuchus.label: Mugger crocodile + Jacana
sarcosuchus.headline: A nomadic marsh crocodile trio run jacana-style by one fierce female, walking overland at night to hunt.
sarcosuchus.setting: Swamps, coastal passages and forest rivers

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.label: Grizzly bear + Saltwater crocodile
spinosaurus.headline: A grizzly that owns its stretch of river and fights like a saltwater crocodile, then relaxes with its rivals at the great falls.

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.label: Black rhinoceros + Grévy's zebra
stegosaurus.headline: A grumpy black rhino with a zebra stallion's family: one bull, three cows, and every bush within 10 body lengths is his.
stegosaurus.setting: Nomad of forests and hills, camping on resource-rich spots

struthiomimus.name: Struthiomimus
struthiomimus.label: Ostrich
struthiomimus.headline: An ostrich flock: harems of hens, incredible running endurance, powerful kicks and the best eyes in the herd.
struthiomimus.setting: Vast open lands, alongside other herbivore herds

styracosaurus.name: Styracosaurus
styracosaurus.label: Musk ox + Gemsbok (oryx)
styracosaurus.headline: The 'attack dog' of the ceratopsian herd: a musk-ox wall with oryx-style hit-and-run chargers.
styracosaurus.setting: Nomad of dense forests and arid grasslands

suchomimus.name: Suchomimus
suchomimus.label: Gharial + Coyote
suchomimus.headline: A fish-snatching gharial with a coyote's calculating mind, and a cuckoo's trick for getting Spinosaurus to raise its young.
suchomimus.setting: Drifts between resource-rich lakes and rivers

tenontosaurus.name: Tenontosaurus
tenontosaurus.label: White-lipped peccary + Common marmoset
tenontosaurus.headline: A peccary herd sharing one scent and fighting as a team, run marmoset-style by one matriarch with doting fathers.
tenontosaurus.setting: Forest territories, dug up for tubers

thalassodromeus.name: Thalassodromeus
thalassodromeus.label: Pigeon + Black-headed gull
thalassodromeus.headline: A huge, chatty pigeon flock of the inland rivers that eats like a gull: fish, stolen scraps and messy dive-bombing.

therizinosaurus.name: Therizinosaurus
therizinosaurus.label: Cassowary
therizinosaurus.headline: A cassowary blown up to Apex size: dagger-clawed, forest-dwelling, ruled by aggressive females while the gentle males raise the chicks.

torvosaurus.name: Torvosaurus
torvosaurus.label: African lion
torvosaurus.headline: A lion pride: the females hunt by day, the male guards the pride and fights off takeovers, and neighbouring prides team up on giants.
torvosaurus.setting: Sedentary pride country: canyons, coasts, hills and forest edges

tropeognathus.name: Tropeognathus
tropeognathus.label: Herring gull + Great cormorant
tropeognathus.headline: A cheeky seagull colony that dives for fish like a cormorant and turns into a pack hunter at night.

tylosaurus.name: Tylosaurus
tylosaurus.label: Orca
tylosaurus.headline: An orca matriline: the eldest mother leads, every family has its own hunting culture, and nothing in the sea is safe.

tyrannosaurus.name: Tyrannosaurus
tyrannosaurus.label: Polar bear + Tawny owl
tyrannosaurus.headline: A polar bear's patience and power, living like a pair of tawny owls: mated for life, owning a forest, striking from cover.

tyrannotitan.name: Tyrannotitan
tyrannotitan.label: Tiger + Great white shark
tyrannotitan.headline: A nocturnal tiger with a great white shark's bite: booming calls in the dark, then prey bleeding out behind it.
tyrannotitan.setting: Large territories across hills, forests and wetlands

utahraptor.name: Utahraptor
utahraptor.label: Grey wolf (family pack) + Bowerbird
utahraptor.headline: A Yellowstone-style wolf family pack around an alpha pair, at war with rival packs, where suitors court with bowerbird gifts.
utahraptor.setting: Pack territories in canyons, hills and forests

yunnanosaurus.name: Yunnanosaurus
yunnanosaurus.label: Moose + Red kangaroo
yunnanosaurus.headline: Calm and sociable in the dry season, furious as a rutting moose in the rain: it rears up like a boxing kangaroo, beats its chest and stomps small predators.
yunnanosaurus.setting: Seasonal: arid ground in the rains, lush waterside in the dry

yutyrannus.name: Yutyrannus
yutyrannus.label: Snow leopard + Arctic fox
yutyrannus.headline: A snow leopard that lives in a playful arctic-fox family: cold-loving, den-dwelling, and bold enough to hunt the biggest predators.
yutyrannus.setting: Cool, rainy-season forests and hills; dens
